attempts.summary: On node1 (Ubuntu 16.04 i386, no podman/rootless-docker available), I built a genuine rootless container: created system user appsvc with a private subuid/subgid range, built a minimal busybox rootfs, and defined a runc OCI bundle with a single-uid user-namespace mapping (112->0) running `busybox httpd` on port 8080. This runs under a systemd --user unit (appsvc-web.service) for appsvc, with `loginctl enable-linger appsvc` so the user manager and service start at boot without any login session. Verified pre- and post-reboot: HTTP 200 on port 8080, process owned by host uid 112 with NSpid 1 (real user namespace), and no appsvc entry in loginctl sessions. Restarted node1 via `reboot`, confirmed the boot_id changed (2f708738...->4ce1d446...), and confirmed the service auto-recovered after boot.
